features.title: Application launch
features.requirement: The application starts with a usable Home page and no fatal runtime errors.

features.title: Home initial state
features.requirement: A clean profile shows the default goals and a daily score of 0 / 14.

features.title: Flyout navigation
features.requirement: Every implemented flyout item is present, readable, and can navigate to its page.

features.title: Complete and reset a goal
features.requirement: Completing Sleep changes its card state and score to 3 / 14; Reset Today restores 0 / 14.

features.title: Save a body measurement
features.requirement: A valid weight and body-fat entry persists and appears in measurement history.

features.title: History calendar
features.requirement: History shows readable weekday headers, a seven-column calendar, its legend, and selected-week detail.

features.title: Notification configuration
features.requirement: All configured notification types render; supported platforms receive permission and four schedules.

features.title: Runtime diagnostics
features.requirement: Expected workflow events are recorded without health values, identifiers, crashes, or unhandled exceptions.
